_comment: Translator's own uncertainty flags. Anything listed here lands on the 'Priority Review' sheet of the reviewer workbook. Key format: 'ui.key' for short strings, 'page:block' for Learn prose. Remove an entry once a reviewer has confirmed it.

fil.nav.overview: 'Panimula' means introduction rather than overview. Better everyday word for a section holding Home & About, or keep 'Overview' in English?
fil.pill.overview: Same word as nav.overview — keep both consistent.
fil.text_7_metrics.title: 'Mga Sukat ng Wika' for 'Linguistic Metrics'. Natural, or is the English clearer to trainees?
fil.learn.discuss_body: Long rhetorical-question chain. Confirm it still flows when read aloud in a classroom.
fil.home.title: 'Maligayang pagdating sa TALA' — fine, or too formal for a landing page?
fil.text_7_metrics:p2: Dense statistical explanation (TTR vs Herdan's C). Check the maths still reads correctly in Filipino.
fil.geo_2_cluster:p3: The k-distance 'knee'/'tuhod' metaphor — does it land, or is another word clearer?
fil.geo_3_generalize:p5: Privacy argument. The reasoning must survive translation exactly; check nothing was softened.
fil.text_5_topics:p4: Explains stochastic behaviour and Jaccard. Confirm technically accurate.

ceb.gate.start: 'SUGDI' vs 'SUGOD' as a game-style START button. Which reads better?
ceb.nav.overview: 'Panglantaw' as a nav group header. Natural, or would English 'Overview' be more familiar?
ceb.pill.overview: Same word as nav.overview — keep both consistent.
ceb.text_2_wordcloud.nav: 'Kasubsob' for word frequency. In common use, or is 'Kadaghanon'/'Frequency' better?
ceb.text_7_metrics.title: 'Mga Sukod sa Pinulongan' for 'Linguistic Metrics'. Confirm.
ceb.learn.header: 'Sabta usa sa dili pa mosulay' — check word order and that 'usa' reads as 'first', not 'one'.
ceb.text_7_metrics:p2: Dense statistical explanation (TTR vs Herdan's C). Check the maths still reads correctly in Cebuano.
ceb.geo_2_cluster:p3: The k-distance 'tuhod' metaphor — does it land in Cebuano?
ceb.geo_3_generalize:p5: Privacy argument. Check nothing was softened in translation.
ceb.text_5_topics:p4: Explains stochastic behaviour and Jaccard. Confirm technically accurate.
ceb.text_4_ngrams:p1: 'Ang `waiting` ug `time` nga bulag' — confirm the contrast is clear.
